description: Na₂Ca₃B₅H₂S₂O₁₈Cl crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six O and one Cl atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.76 Å. The Na-Cl bond length is 2.97 Å. There are two inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.69 Å. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven O and one Cl atom. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.58 Å. The Ca-Cl bond length is 2.87 Å. There are three inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.51 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.37-1.39 Å. In the third B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.47 Å) and two longer (1.52 Å) B-O bond lengths. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.52 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ca and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Ca and two B atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ca, one B, and one H atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ca, and two B atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Ca and two B atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Ca and two B atoms. Cl is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ca atoms.
